intel.title: ANPR and Barrier Systems
intel.text: Symonds Yat Rock uses barrierless ANPR for parking payments via card or RingGo; the Kymin has a small National Trust car park with no toilets.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: The reviewed official sources do not establish mobile coverage at these stops. Save directions before departure rather than assuming reception.

intel.title: Supply Stations
intel.text: The reviewed official sources do not establish fuel-station locations or operating hours. Check your refuelling options independently before departure.

intel.title: Avoiding Crowds
intel.text: Symonds Yat Rock is typically less busy on weekdays outside school holidays, specifically before 10 AM or after 4 PM.

intel.title: Narrow Lane Restrictions
intel.text: The road to the Kymin is steep with hairpin bends and is not suitable for coaches; Symonds Yat car park is locked nightly.
